g.text: ATMOSPHERIC COLUMN C-101 - FLASH ZONE & BOTTOMS
1. Trays 1-25 and overhead on CFU-100-PR-PID-007. Stripping section trays 36-41 (6 trays, 4.1 m ID).
2. Overflash measured on external loop FI-1080 (minimum overflash alarm, APC constraint).
3. EIV-1121 remotely operated isolation valve (ROSOV), fire-safe, actuated from CCR / field (SIF-204).
4. P-112 minimum flow returns to C-101 sump via RO.
5. Line numbers: <NPS>-<fluid>-<area>-<seq>-<class>-<insulation> per CONVENTIONS; see line list CFU-000-PI-LL-001.
6. All vents / drains 3/4" min. with blind or cap; HPV/LPD to piping specification. Valve sizes = line size UNO.
7. Instrument tags per ISA-5.1; index CFU-000-IC-IDX-001. SIS functions per SRS (SIF tags shown in interlocks).
ID 6.9 m (top/main) / 3.5 m (stripping) x 37.0 m T/T
MAT'L CS + 410S clad below tray 10; Monel 400 lined top head & trays 1-5
SP FROM LIC-1082; RATIO-SPLITS H-201 PASSES
